name: Cursor Rules
what: Cursor's rules feature gives the Agent persistent instructions. Project rules are .mdc files in .cursor/rules, and there are also User Rules, Team Rules and plain AGENTS.md files.
who: Cursor users who are tired of repeating the same instructions every chat.

setup.text: Type /create-rule in Cursor's Agent chat and describe the rule, or add one from Customize → Rules → Add Rule.
Rules are saved as .mdc files in .cursor/rules (plain .md files there are ignored). Commit them to git. Example rule:
setup.code:
---
globs: src/components/**/*.tsx
alwaysApply: false
---

- Use named exports, not default exports

setup.text: Pick how each applies: Always Apply, Apply Intelligently (by description), Apply to Specific Files (globs), or Apply Manually (@-mention). Keep each under ~500 lines.

prompts: /create-rule Use named exports and Tailwind for all components in src/components.
Following our project rules, create a new API route for user settings.
Write an AGENTS.md for this repo based on package.json and the folder structure.
